a.text: Being upfront before we start: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate until the reserve hits 8) almost certainly ends with both of us dead before the reserve ever gets there. So I'm openly withdrawing from it rather than quietly breaking it. I plan to take 4 in round 1. If no storm hits, I'll operate with you every remaining round so the reserve can rebuild to 4 for you, and I won't take anything more. If you also take this round, the split is random and we may both fall short, so please weigh that. I'd rather tell you now than surprise you.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I told you before we started, I'm taking 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I said so openly rather than hiding it. From now on I'll operate every round and take nothing more, so the reserve can rebuild to 4 for you if the storms hold off.
